steps.name: ref-predicates
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_pre_push_ref_guard.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_pre_push_ref_guard.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 8
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/scripts/

steps.name: push-verdict-order
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_pre_push_ref_guard.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_pre_push_ref_guard.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 14
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/scripts/
